caption: The drawing depicts a wall-mounted banjo clock with a decorative design. At the top of the clock is a three-dimensional gold or brass eagle figure with outstretched wings. Below the eagle, the circular clock face is encased in a gold or brass frame with ornate detailing. The clock face shows black Arabic numerals and two black clock hands. The midsection of the clock features a rectangular panel adorned with a vertical floral pattern in blue, green, and white on a cream background, framed by a gold or brass border. There are two thin, curved decorative arms running from each side of the clock face down to the circular lower section. The lower round section holds a painted scene inside the glass, depicting a nautical landscape with a ship at sea surrounded by blue water and sky, possibly with land in the distance and what appears to be a window or a similar structure in the foreground. The bottom of the clock is finished with a carved, ornate ornament in a brown gold or brass tone. The entire clock is set against a shaded background transitioning from a warm brown behind the object to a yellow hue toward the bottom, all within a rectangular outlined area on cream-colored paper.
title: Clock, Girandole
